changes: Added a first-class non-runtime product capability release ledger (.lattice/capability-releases.jsonl) mirroring artifact-release: core/capability-release.ts with schema, merge-stable capabilityDigest, mainCommit-free idempotencyKey, PCR- id, and a fail-closed reader. DONE classifies + records a capability release at BOTH completion sites (done-effects.ts + done-recover.ts). PlaybookLineage gains optional capability fields; DONE candidate ingest binds capabilityReleaseId. New read-only capability_release_list/status CLI (6-site registration); playbook_promotion_status surfaces candidate capability lineage.
usage: lattice capability_release_list --format=json ; lattice capability_release_status --storyId=B-785e --format=json ; lattice playbook_promotion_status --json
expectedOutcome: capability_release_status renders the product capability release record(s) for a story; a DONE candidate playbook lineage carries capabilityReleaseId/capabilityId/capabilityVersion; the reader fails closed on authority/gateEvidence tampering.
actualTranscript: capability_release_list --format=json returns the ledger array ([] on an empty ledger); capability_release_status --storyId=B-785e --format=json returns {"storyId":"B-785e","count":0,"latest":null,"records":[]}; playbook_promotion_status shows capabilityRelease=<id> (<capabilityId> v<version>) per candidate.
outcomeDiff: No difference — the shipped read-only CLI output matches the expected shapes; all four capability smokes green and lattice validate 30/30 covered.
limitations: The standalone capability_release_backfill CLI command and the M6 pending-learning exposure / M7 promotion command surfaces are deferred to a named follow-up story; V1 ships a hermetic fixture backfill proof and asserts the already-enforced M6/M7 invariants (matchActivePlaybook status guard; done-settlement != helped).
pitfalls: Follow the audited rev2 execution plan. capabilityDigest MUST be merge-stable (exclude mainCommit) or recovery re-merge duplicates; the classifier must wire into BOTH done-effects.ts and done-recover.ts; PlaybookLineage widening must keep fields OPTIONAL (existing 3-field rows parse) with idempotency on canonicalSourceKey, not digest; register the CLI at all six sites incl config.ts DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS. Expect the high-risk assurance floor (command-policy.ts is a lifecycle path) plus 7 low/medium review findings to require the 3-round floor, and re-stamp evidence after fixes and the main merge.
